# Data Pipeline Assumptions Note 2

We assume that data pipeline handling of compaction interacts with orchestrator; teams noted that staleness depends on dedupe and retry, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that data pipeline handling of sink interacts with backfill; teams noted that latency depends on offset and partition, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: data pipeline handling of materialize interacts with source; teams noted that lineage depends on schema and consumer, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that data pipeline handling of checkpoint interacts with throughput; teams noted that transform depends on streaming and batch, especially under real production load.
